raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

The packed CP attention/gradient parity test introduced in #7469 has reported intermittent similarity failures in merge-queue runs [38405562363](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/38405562363/job/115325941729) and [37960573360](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/37960573360/job/113926645761).

## What changed

Add `@pytest.mark.flaky` and `@pytest.mark.flaky_in_dev` to `test_packed_cp_matches_full_attention_and_gradients`.

## Details

The existing CI filters exclude this test in LTS and dev respectively. All parametrized cases receive both markers. Test code, assertions, tolerances, and other tests are unchanged.

## Tested

- Passed `git diff --check` and exact scope verification: one file, two added decorator lines.
- Removing those two lines restores byte-identical source.
- Verified commit signature and pushed fork head.
- Repository lint and GPU tests were not run locally. GPU execution was excluded for this marker-only quarantine; authoritative CI results are pending.
